purpose: Versioned evaluation thresholds. A revision must bump version, append one changelog entry per new version, and state, for every numeric change, which metric moved and in which direction. Lowering a target is a deliberate act that needs a written reason in the entry; the change-management hook in bangla_gpt_api.evaluation.thresholds enforces this.

gate.note: tolerance_pp must equal bangla_gpt_api.evaluation.metrics.GATE_PP; a test asserts it so the pre-registration cannot drift from the code that runs in CI.

targets_note: A8-08 proposals, unchanged: they are targets to report against, not the CI gate. The CI gate is the 2pp regression rule above. Measuring the sample corpus saturates recall_at_5 at 1.0 (see eval/strata_report.json mde_degenerate_ceiling), so the reported recall_at_5 cannot currently fail the target on that corpus; the real-corpus retrieval families in data/nctb/retrieval_eval.json are the measurement that can.

changelog.change: Initial pre-registration: gate tolerance 2pp against eval/baseline_v2.json, primary retrieval metric recall_at_5 reported on the frozen test split (hash recorded), A8-08 targets recorded verbatim. No metric was moved from a previous value.
